sentences.text: Order No.10/ Dated:20.02.2023 Heard learned counsel for the parties.

Apprehending his arrest in connection with Sakchi P.S. Case No. 72 of 2021 instituted under Sections 498A/ 494/ 420// 406/ 506/ 323/ 494 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860, the petitioner has moved to this Court for grant of privilege of anticipatory bail.
As per F.I.R., marriage between the parties was solemnized in the year 2015 and out of their wedlock they have no issue.
It is alleged that informant after marriage found out that her husband is already married and has concealed the same from her.
Due to which, he used to physically and mentally torture her, for the same a case by the informant has also been filed earlier.
Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that petitioner is innocent and has committed no offence at all rather he has been falsely implicated in this case.

It is submitted that on earlier occasion also a case under Section 498(A) has been instituted against the petitioner, the case was compromised between the parties through mutual consent and the matter was also withdrawn.
Maintenance case filed by the informant is also pending.
It is apparent that there is matrimonial discord between the parties, which is irreconcilable.

It is lastly submitted that the petitioner undertakes to co-operate with the investigation of the case and also abide by all terms and conditions which may be imposed in the matter of granting anticipatory bail to the petitioner.
Hence, the petitioner may be extended the privilege of anticipatory bail.
Learned Addl.P.P appearing for the State opposes the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioner.
Considering the facts and circumstances of this case, the nature of allegation coupled with materials on record, I am inclined to grant privilege of anticipatory bail to the petitioner.

Accordingly, the petitioner is directed to surrender in the Court below within four weeks from today and in the event Pandit Rama Krishan @ Ramesh Surya ... vs The State Of Jharkhand on 20 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/151553073/

Case No. 72 of 2021 with the condition that he will co-operate with the investigation of the case and appear before the investigating officer as and when noticed by him and furnish his mobile number and photocopy of the Aadhar Card with an undertaking that he will not change his mobile number during the pendency of the case and subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
